Question: AstraZeneca, a British pharmaceutical giant, has admitted that its Covid-19 vaccine can result in a rare side effect of TTS. Majority of Indians have got this Covishield vaccine and how will it affect Indians?
Old_Answer: We all take Paracetamol. Do you know that an “unintentional” overdose of Paracetamols is the most common cause of acute liver failure in the UK and USA? So, should we stop taking Paracetamol? For the first time AstraZeneca (the company that made the Covishield Vaccine with Oxford University) has accepted that in very very rare cases, the Covishield vaccine can cause a type of blood clotting (a disease called TTS). There have been earlier reports in media that the Covishield can cause TTS but the company has accepted this for the first time. But Covishield is not the only Corona vaccine that has side effects. All other major Corona vaccines like Pfizer, Moderna, Jhonson & Jhonson have known side effects. Covishield is a traditional vaccine but the Pfizer and Moderna vaccine uses the new mRNA technology and many people across the world have accused these mRNA vaccines of many side effects (like fatal heart attacks, deadly heart problems etc). Around 80 to 90 percent of Indians have received Covishield vaccine. The Covishield vaccine was given the go-ahead by almost every country of the world. Covishield was also approved by WHO. India’s Serum Institute was the biggest manufacturer of the Covishield vaccine and India exported these vaccines to over 90 countries. Normally it takes 5 to 10 years to develop a vaccine but the Coronavirus Pandemic was such a big threat to humanity that scientists across the globe created many vaccines within a few months and all Governments gave them emergency usage certificates. Ideally, these vaccines should not have been approved so quickly but it was a race against time. Some people in the world may have died or may have got complicated diseases due to Corona vaccine (cases are going on in courts of Western countries) but these vaccines have saved millions of lives. As per AstraZeneca’s statement in British Court, the company said that their Covishield vaccine saved the lives of 65 million people worldwide. Goverments had to take decision and they chose a path which has saved much more lives. We all remember the horrors of the second wave of the Coronavirus Pandemic when India was brought to its knees by the virus but we were able to take subsequent waves due to Covishield vaccine. The other option for India was the Pfizer mRNA vaccine and later it turned out that this vaccine also had some side effects. Pfizer Vaccine was very costly (Covishield was not patented and its formula was given to India without profit by Oxford University) it needed deep freezers to keep it very cool. India could have afforded the cost of the Pfizer Vaccine but India could not have distributed these vaccines due to lack of deep freezers in remote villages. Almost all of us would have lost many of our family members and friends without Covishield. This has saved the lives of millions of Indians who would have died in 3rd and 4th wave of the pandemic. As per some studies, 2 to 3 lakh people in America have died due to coronavirus due to their refusal to take the vaccine. But at the same time, let’s accept the side effects also. There is not a single drug in the world that has no side effects. And many more Indians die due to “casual” use of antibiotics. If you want to keep your family safe please stop using eating antibiotic tablets in normal circumstances. And most of the side effects of Coronavirus vaccines are seen in the first few days/months of taking the vaccine doses. So, we all are safe and there is no need to panic. If you get blood clotting then consult doctor and take the prescribed medication. As per some reports the side effect has been seen in less than 40 people out of 1.75 cr plus people and the rate of side effect is 0.00000007%. I support the decision of the Modi Govt. and our institutions (like IMCR) to use Covishield in 2021. That was the best decision based on the circumstances. That was a war-like situation and the decision was 100% correct based on all the available information. And, I also the Serum Institute which produced so many vaccines very quickly. Do you know that some people die due to drinking “excess” milk? Do you know that wheat increases the chances of death in some diseases? Do you know that some people have died after eating rice? If you are eating any medicine (or even food) then please go and read the side effects of those on the internet. There are almost 8 billion people on the earth and everything is bad for someone.

Question: Is Kejriwal’s party, the AAM Aadmi Party, finished?

In Indian political history, never a regional party has ruled two states (when AAP won Punjab it was a regional party). Only national parties like Congress, BJP, CPM, and defunct national parties (Like Janta Party, and Janta Dal) have ruled two states. This may remain one of the greatest achievements of Arvind Kejriwal he has won two states - Delhi and Punjab. His control in the Delhi assembly is so strong that the party has won more than 60 seats (out of 70 seats) in two consecutive elections. AAP is a party that was born out of a movement and it portrayed itself as a different and clean party. AAP used to claim that they were the “cleanest” political party. In the last few years, AAP has lost that moral high ground and it has become another usual political party. Thus AAP has lost its main capital of being an honest party. Irrespective of the outcome of the liquor scam, Kejriwal’s image took a massive hit when the reports came out that Kejriwal had used more than 52 cr. in the renovation of CM’s house. But their politics has remained the same and somehow they have managed to keep their political relevance. If a Lalu can remain politically relevant then why can’t Arvind Kejriwal remain politically relevant? But there is one weak point of Kejriwal - Kejriwal doesn't have a permanent dedicated vote bank like Lalu Yadav. In case Congress can revive itself in Delhi and Punjab then it will hurt AAP. Muslims and poor voters of Delhi can dump AAP and go to Congress the same way they dumped Congress and went into AAP’s fold. But I don’t see Congress climbing the charts rapidly in Delhi. So, AAP’s future is secure in Delhi in the near and medium term. What can go wrong in the 2025 Delhi Assembly election for AAP?
